verdict.rationale: Lever offers several AI-generated insight/suggestion features: Talent Fit AI-powered candidate matching, AI Interview Transcripts and Summaries with actionable recaps, and AI-generated interview questions/forms. These are concrete AI-driven insights surfaced inside the product, but evidence is vendor marketing only, lacking depth on how insights are surfaced (e.g., proactive dashboards, natural-language querying of data) or independent validation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration, detail on breadth/accuracy of AI insights across the whole dataset, and evidence of conversational or dashboard-level AI insight generation beyond specific point features.
